newsitem.title: USA: Moreno Valley, Calif., taxes approved - officials.
newsitem.headline: Moreno Valley, Calif., taxes approved - officials.

text.p: Voters in Moreno Valley, Calif., approved two local tax measures, ensuring that $7.5 million of revenue from the taxes continues to flow into the city's general fund budget, officials said Wednesday.
The utility and business tax measures were approved Tuesday. Both were raised by the city council in 1991 but were scheduled to expire in December without voter approval.
If the tax measures had failed, the city would have become "dysfunctional," and would have been forced to slash police, fire and other municipal services, Gene Rogers, the interim city manager, said.
The $7.5 million raised annually with the taxes represents about a quarter of the city's general fund.
The Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association had threatened to sue Moreno Valley over the taxes.
